node: Housing repair, remodel and maintenance input suppliers
summary: Layer 1B expansion for housing repair, remodel and maintenance input suppliers found a more useful underfollowed lane in specialty distribution and contractor-facing inventory networks than in obvious homebuilders or big-box retail. The strongest second-order mappings are roofing and waterproofing distribution, HVAC/R replacement distribution, landscape maintenance and repair/upgrade distribution, and small-cap specialty building-products distribution. This is not a buy/sell list; it is a research universe for later evidence testing.
